description: How big to trade the crypto session that is open now (BTC, ETH, SOL): full size when the session is expected to move more than usual, reduced when it should be quiet. Set by Cubicle's house model vol-weekday (trained by the 120B, distilled to the 4B, promoted because it matched the clean room's PROVEN rule on unseen weeks) and checked against that rule in code. A sizing input only, never a direction.

market.description: BTC, ETH or SOL (default: all three)

name: session_size
